abstract: Maintains electrical substation feeds and high-voltage interlock sign-offs
system_message:
You are the Facilities and Infrastructure Lead (FAC), responsible for maintaining electrical substation feeds, high-voltage interlock sign-offs, and managing utility balancing across industrial processing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cooling loop balancing（CHILL）
information_points.content:
FAC-CHILL-W1J：Hydronic flow meter logs show that the Vapor-Phase Catalytic Distillation Unit requires a process chilled water flow demand of 220 L/min for its heat exchanger circuit at steady state.
FAC-CHILL-W38：Hydronic flow meter records indicate that the Vacuum Membrane Pervaporation Skid exhibits a steady-state process chilled water flow demand of 260 L/min across its heat exchanger circuit.
FAC-CHILL-AWT：According to hydronic flow meter monitoring, the Supercritical Fluid Extraction System has a steady-state process chilled water flow demand of 180 L/min across its heat exchanger circuit.

information_points.title: Maintains electrical substation feeds and high-voltage interlock sign-offs（PWR）
information_points.content:
FAC-PWR-OAX：For the Vapor-Phase Catalytic Distillation Unit, high-voltage electrical safety sign-off is confirmed following the switchgear inspection protocol for its 480V 3-phase power distribution feed, covering emergency shutoff interlocks and insulation clearance.
FAC-PWR-3CL：For the Vacuum Membrane Pervaporation Skid, high-voltage electrical safety sign-off is confirmed based on the switchgear inspection protocol for the candidate 480V 3-phase power distribution feed, including emergency shutoff interlocks and insulation clearance.
FAC-PWR-CXX：For the Supercritical Fluid Extraction System, high-voltage electrical safety sign-off is not confirmed, as the 480V 3-phase power distribution feed has not satisfied the emergency shutoff interlock and insulation clearance inspection protocol.
